W.note: Nice small pill, but the opened timeline is misaligned (right-aligned text, orphaned times, dead space at bottom) and has no ETA in detail view.

X.note: Tidy compact toast with progress bar, clear timeline, ETA and carrier tabs, but little aria-live support and no reduced-motion handling.

Y.note: Dense and polished with stepper, scan log, masked tracking number, alerts toggle and pager dots; subtitle truncates slightly when open.

Z.note: Good collapsed pill with count badge, but the opened state has truncated carrier tabs, wrapped tracking number and an orphan Dismiss row.
